case: Question 1's established answer carries two parts; its one review weighs both and names a third part the question asks that the answer leaves out (missing), and is recorded best_candidate. Question 2's partial answer names its open part by the limitation that bounds it; its review holds that part open.
design: docs/adr/0013 'Claim and open-part rows': an answer carries parts [{id, part, status: established | open, refs, open_by?}] against the verbatim revision of its question, present-only in the hashed core; a review's parts name the answer's parts by id and may add one the answer leaves out (missing), never established by it.

docs/adr/0013 'Claim and open-part rows': a part a review says the answer leaves out allows an answer that claims established only best_candidate, as a part held not established does; it stays visible (part_omitted, a warning) until the answer is recorded again with it.
docs/adr/0015 'After the run s9722fa': an answer that claims established, every review of which holds it a best candidate, is held so, by readiness as by the done.

docs/adr/0013 'Claim and open-part rows': a partial answer names at least one open part and what bounds it; a review that holds a part open that the answer's own row holds open does not cap it; partial is a disposition.
